card.name: Start of a longer word after a break
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer medical word that is split after a hyphen, space or heading, such as PRE, Nit, re, Meth. The word is still unfinished and its ending comes next.

modes.label: Hyphenated start
modes.description: A short opening piece after a hyphen or prefix that begins a word like pre-exposure or re-quiring.

modes.label: Start of a drug or term
modes.description: The first part of a drug name or heading word that continues in the next piece.
modes.example: 2.2 Recommended Dosing Sodium<< Nit>>rite Injection and Sodium Thiosulfate

card.writes: It pushes up glucose-like and PG-like pieces and pushes down contract-related words, which suggests no clear meaning beyond word continuation.
card.plain: It lights up when a long medical word has only just begun, such as the first bit of pre-exposure or sodium nitrite.
